interpretation.bound: Current-epoch first allocations only; at this fixed cut the remaining per-direction capacities sum to 2b-1.
interpretation.cryptography: The public recount checks retained outcomes and accounting. Native key reconstruction and reference private-key AEAD audits belong to the original source-bound execution.
interpretation.performance: Observed arbitration costs; no counterfactual throughput or speedup is inferred.
interpretation.prior_delivery_retry: An observed repeated transmission after that request already reached logical delivery; this uses analyst knowledge, not an extra sender oracle.
interpretation.retry_outcomes: Reception events; duplicated network deliveries are counted separately from emission identities.
